name: HEALTHBANE Campaign - Observed vs Inferred
description: HEALTHBANE campaign ATT&CK mapping from 4x02 intelligence intake. Red (score 100) = OBSERVED, direct evidence in at least one source. Amber (score 50) = INFERRED, analytical hypothesis or explicitly source-flagged as likely-but-unconfirmed. See 7-attack_navigator.md for full evidence citations.

techniques.comment: OBSERVED (HC3): attacker held target employee email addresses across >=14 healthcare orgs, evidenced by the spearphishing operation itself.
OBSERVED (HC3, MedDefense, Researcher): Namecheap lookalike domains registered 4-10 days pre-use; exact registration dates confirmed for 3 domains.
OBSERVED (HC3, Researcher): attacker mailbox ops@healthbane-c2.net found directly in kit config.php.
OBSERVED (HC3, Researcher): Stage 2 executable svchost_update.exe and PowerShell exfiltrator sync_healthdata.ps1 attributed to this operator's toolset.
OBSERVED (HC3, MedDefense, Researcher): kit staged on portal-secure-meddefense.com ahead of activation, confirmed via direct researcher access.
OBSERVED (HC3, MedDefense, Researcher): primary Stage 1 vector, 100% of 6 HC3-visible orgs; MedDefense emails E2/E5/E7.
OBSERVED (HC3): Stage 2 .docm macro document sent from a compromised account.
OBSERVED (HC3, MedDefense): dmarsh clicked the Stage 1 link at 2026-04-14 15:02:33 UTC.
OBSERVED (HC3): macro-enabled .docm required user action to enable content.
OBSERVED (HC3): VBA macro in HEALTHBANE_S2_invoice.docm drops the Stage 2 executable.
OBSERVED (HC3, Researcher): sync_healthdata.ps1 extracted directly from the kit's tools/ directory.
OBSERVED (HC3): scheduled task named 'HealthSync Update Service'.
OBSERVED (HC3): Registry Run-key addition confirmed alongside the scheduled task.
INFERRED: HC3 explicitly assesses this as LIKELY (Stage 1 creds reused to authenticate to victim cloud email) but excludes it from its own formal OBSERVED table pending confirmation.
INFERRED: svchost_update.exe filename mimics legitimate svchost.exe naming; no process-tree or code-signing evidence available in any source to confirm masquerading intent.
OBSERVED (HC3, MedDefense): HTML form POST capture via kit handlers/post.php; MedDefense SIEM shows a 47-second HTTPS session consistent with submission.
INFERRED: same HC3 caveat as T1078 -- assessed LIKELY but explicitly excluded from HC3's formal OBSERVED table pending confirmation. No source specifies the remote-service protocol involved.
OBSERVED (HC3): Stage 3 DNS TXT tunneling to data-sync.healthbane-c2.net, confirmed via packet capture at 2 orgs.
OBSERVED (HC3): Stage 2 payload download over HTTPS from healthbane-c2.net.
OBSERVED (HC3 narrative, not in HC3's own formatted table): base32-encoded query labels, base64-encoded TXT response command strings, packet-capture-based HIGH confidence.
OBSERVED (HC3): DNS tunneling exfiltration channel, per HC3's formal table.
OBSERVED (HC3): same DNS channel also carries C2 command responses, per HC3's formal table.
